title: Add further script pairs and additional schemes per pair beyond M0–M2 coverage
context: M4 broadens coverage beyond the initial three script pairs (Cyrillic, Devanagari, Arabic). Additional script families from the backlog include Greek, Hebrew, Georgian, Armenian, Thai, Bengali, Tamil, and cross-script (non-Latin) transforms. Each new script pair requires its own provenance check, qualified per-script reviewer, reversibility analysis, and harness integration. Prioritization follows the rule: secured adopter need > clean open/PD provenance > reviewer availability > under-served population size.
objective: Add at least one additional script pair (selected from: Greek, Hebrew, Georgian, Armenian, Thai, Bengali, Tamil ↔ Latin, or a cross-script pair) following the complete M0–M2 process for that pair: license/provenance check, scheme authoring, golden vectors, harness integration, qualified reviewer sign-off. Each pair is scoped, provenance-checked, and reviewed independently.
acceptanceCriteria: At least one new script pair added beyond Cyrillic/Devanagari/Arabic, selected per the prioritization rule: secured adopter need > clean open/PD provenance > reviewer availability > under-served population size

New scheme follows the full M0–M2 process: license/provenance gate confirmed before authoring, scheme validates against mappingSchemeSchema, reversibility class correctly tagged and enforced by checker, golden vectors (>= 50), harness green in CI
Qualified per-script reviewer (+ second reviewer if strict claim or first in family) sign-off recorded
Provenance allow-list updated with new sources specific to the added script pair; sources have verified open/PD/CC/OFL terms
Per-scheme docs written with the not-certified disclaimer
If a cross-script (non-Latin↔non-Latin) pair is added: reversibility analysis across the composition chain is documented; no false strict claims for the composed pair
resources: PLAN.md — M4 definition; Scope (prioritization rule); Backlog/future (candidate script families)
TASKS.md — scale-001 description and M4 acceptance criteria
tasks/open-transliteration-integration-001.json — adopter input on which pairs to prioritize
UNGEGN systems for additional script families
Unicode CLDR / ICU transform data for additional scripts
output: data/schemes/<new-scheme-id>.yaml (+ compiled JSON); data/vectors/<new-scheme-id>/ golden vectors; data/review/<new-scheme-id>.yaml; updated provenance allow-list; per-scheme docs
